summary: David says that the Lord has scattered His people—The Lord places Ephraim at the head and makes Judah His lawgiver.
meta_description: David says that the Lord has scattered His people—The Lord places Ephraim at the head and makes Judah His lawgiver.
section_headings: To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.

footnotes.note8_b: OR over Philistia will I triumph. See Ps. 108:9.
